projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for C and C++
description: C11/C++17 on-premise Device Detection (.hash files) and IP Intelligence (.ipi files). After cmake --install (CMake 3.24+), call find_package(51Degrees CONFIG REQUIRED) and link 51Degrees::hash-c, 51Degrees::hash-cxx, 51Degrees::ip-intelligence-c, or 51Degrees::ip-intelligence-cxx. Include <51degrees/dd/hash/hash.h> or <51degrees/ipi/EngineIpi.hpp>. Human Confidence and Identifiers are cloud only. Install with git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/51Degrees/51degrees-cxx.git
